mapper.select: SELECT question_id FROM question WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND question_id = #{questionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT account_id, question_id, file_ref, save_request_id, request_hash, state, saved_at, completed_at FROM question_answer WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND question_id = #{questionId}

INSERT INTO question_answer(account_id, question_id, file_ref, save_request_id, request_hash, state) VALUES (#{answer.accountId}, #{answer.questionId}, #{answer.fileRef}, #{answer.saveRequestId}, #{answer.requestHash}, 'IN_PROGRESS') ON CONFLICT (account_id, question_id) DO UPDATE SET file_ref = EXCLUDED.file_ref, save_request_id = EXCLUDED.save_request_id, request_hash = EXCLUDED.request_hash, state = 'IN_PROGRESS', saved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = NULL RETURNING account_id, question_id, file_ref, save_request_id, request_hash, state, saved_at, completed_at
